description: Read selected source-checked links between registrations, protocols, preprints, primary reports and follow-up analyses. Provide a visible record ID to inspect its families, or omit it for the small reviewed catalogue. Includes exact DOI/NCT identities, report roles, source URLs, check dates and limitations. Coverage is incomplete; never assume unlinked records are independent studies.

id.description: The numeric string ID returned by search, not a DOI or URL.

name: get_study_relationships
title: Read verified study-family links
